title: A number that differs only in upper or lower case is not linked
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NEAR-01), in upper case, is stocked at {Location-B} only, with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Near Library).
  • {Location-A} stocks no part whose number matches {Part-A} in any form.
  • {Number-A} (for example zzautotest-pl-near-01) is {Part-A} typed all in lower case.
  • The description you will type is {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Near Lower).
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type {Description-B} in Description.
  3. Type {Number-A} in Part Number.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
  8. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Number-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the part is saved and the window closes. No "Linked to … in the Part Library" message appears.
  • Step 7: two separate entries now show: {Part-A} with {Description-A}, and {Number-A}, saved in lower case exactly as typed, with {Description-B} (1 + 1 = 2).
  • Step 8: at {Location-A} one row shows {Number-A} with {Description-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-R4, S7-R7, §4 Key Decisions, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Saved and linked to the Part Library entry), board 7.1 (Part Library), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R4: “On save, the system looks for a Part Library entry whose number is exactly the number typed, including upper and lower case.”
  • S7-R7: “If no entry matches, the system creates a Part Library entry with the typed number and description, and links the part to it.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (exact link): “In the New Inventory Part dialog, a new part links to an existing Part Library entry only on an exact match. Exact means the same characters, including upper and lower case. Any other number gets an entry of its own. A near match is never linked, because two different products can share a number that differs only in punctuation, and linking them would merge them.”
